traj_tests.note: weights 1/3/5 by severity, guards negative; component weight = mean of the absolute test weights (informational; reward.toml sets the channel weights).

rubric.note: component weight = mean of the absolute criterion source weights (informational; reward.toml sets the channel weights).

pass_rule: a run passes when reward.json reward >= threshold; reward = max(0, 0.5*pytest + 0.5*rubric) (tests/reward/reward.toml, rewardkit weighted-mean); pytest = max(0, (earned - tripped guard weight) / 37); rubric = max(0, sum(satisfied source_weight) / 34) with penalties signed; with no judge the rubric is dropped and reward = pytest. No gate: a tripped guard subtracts its weight; suite, preservation and variant credit each require a working repair and a reproducing agent reproducer inside the test itself.
guard_polarity_note: each test_negative_weight_* returns/asserts true when it DETECTS the violation, so a guard is charged when its test passes.
